summary_md:
**[@0xBakeer](https://x.com/0xBakeer/status/2115390623125831798)** benchmarks six models on one DGX Spark with an identical test (8 requests, 512 tokens each, temp 1.0, thinking off, 3 rounds) now shown on every model card in **TandemLLM 0.15.0**.

- Single request: lfm2.5-24b-a2b ~123 tok/s, flint ~108, flash-next ~44, qwen3.8-27b ~35, bolt ~35, ornith-1.5-122b ~35.
- Eight at once: lfm2.5 ~239, flint ~216, qwen3.8-27b ~146, flash-next ~108, bolt ~92, ornith-1.5-122b ~86.
- Notable: the dense 27B scales ~4.1× from 1→8 requests while everything else gains only ~1.9–2.6×, lifting it to third under load.
relevance: Apples-to-apples Spark throughput across the 24B–122B range, including a 120B-class model, for picking a mid vs max tier.
